correctness.rationale: Read exact arbitrary-field proof in assigned RESULT.md. If image of ideal in A/J=k^V contains vertex v, choose z=e_vxe_v=lambda e_v+ell with ell a loop-linear element in J. Identity z^2-2lambda z=-lambda^2 e_v forces e_v in ideal even in characteristic 2. Peirce left/right idempotents split the rest into W_uv, and multiplying forced vertices includes all incident arrows; converse closed since J^2=0. Fixed rank block subspace loci are closed products of Gr(r_uv,a_uv). Distinct rank/support pieces are disjoint projective, hence disjoint closed and yield the reduction of the full ideal scheme (without nonreduced claim). Over F_q Gaussian counts multiply; simple orientations each have optional one-dimensional blocks and no q-dependence; parallel pair vs oppositely directed arrows gives different q-dependent count. Independently enumerated all subspaces and directly tested two-sided closure for four small binary quivers (single arrow, opposite arrows, length-two path, loop), matching the predicted dimension polynomials; source supplied 22 additional check configurations but those logs are not independent proof.
